squat.cue: Hit parallel — thighs level with the floor
Chest up, slight forward lean is okay

bicep_curl.cue: Pin elbows to your sides throughout
Keep wrists neutral, don't bend them back

tricep_pushdown.cue: Slight forward lean is fine, stay controlled
tricep_pushdown.avoid: Hinging at the hips to use bodyweight

shoulder_press.avoid: Arching lower back to push the weight

shoulder_press.cue: Press straight up, bar close to your face
